findings.issue: Single-region deployment with no failover capability
findings.recommendation: Deploy across multiple Azure regions or availability zones. Use Azure Traffic Manager or Azure Front Door for global load balancing and automatic failover.

findings.issue: Key Vault should have soft-delete and purge protection enabled
findings.recommendation: Enable soft-delete (90-day retention) and purge protection to prevent accidental deletion of secrets, keys, and certificates.

findings.issue: Public-facing application without Web Application Firewall (WAF)
findings.recommendation: Deploy Azure Front Door with WAF or Application Gateway with WAF to protect against OWASP Top 10 threats, DDoS, and bot attacks.
